text:
alex: seeing a sudden p99 jump on hosted API at ~13:02 UTC, not correlated with deploys. p95 up too. digging into queuing.
maria: same, dashboards show queue depth + request backlogs in the async coalescer layer for several hosts.
jamie: logs show a surge of small requests that have weirdly long kernel exec times (~20-40ms vs usual 5-8ms). suspect batching padding change.
alex: can you paste the slow stack traces / kernel selection logs?
jamie: pasted below from host i-08f: 
```
[2026-03-17T13:02:18Z] kernel_selector: chosen=fp16_v2 exec_ms=34 batch=1 seq=512
[2026-03-17T13:02:18Z] batching: async_pad=enabled pad_to=64 coalesce_wait_ms=6
[2026-03-17T13:02:18Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.12 eviction_ratelimit=high
```
ryan: odd that batch=1 with pad_to=64 — that padding can blow up per-token kernels for short requests, switching kernel family.
maria: rate limiter metrics show token-rate stayed normal, but allowed request concurrency jumped due to quota window lapse for a tenant (ten-42) — noisy neighbor?
jamie: profilers show increased memcpy on kernel handoff path when pad_to > 0 and batch small. attaching flame snippet (trimmed): 
```
memcpy_host_to_dev  45%
kernel_launch_overhead 22%
quantize_dequantize 15%
attention_kernel_v2 10%
```
sre-bot: deploybot: no deploys in last 24h. autoscaler: added nodes at 13:07 UTC.
alex: hypothesis: a recent heuristic tweak enabled async batch padding globally, which causes single-request executions to pick a different kernel family with higher overhead. combined with tenant concurrency spike that created many small batches -> p99.
ryan: can we repro by forcing pad_to=0 on a few hosts and running the small-request load?
maria: rolling a config patch to disable async_pad on two noisy hosts now. will monitor. (reacted with :eyes:)
jamie: also bumping kernel selector logs to debug to capture exact kernel ids and histograms.
alex: if this confirms, patch needs: revert global async_pad default and add a heuristic: enable padding only when batch_size >= 8 OR median_seq_len >= 128.
ryan: noted. also check KV cache churn — high miss_rate could cause more long-running priming calls, exacerbating tail. set kv_cache eviction throttle lower for ten-42.
maria: hosts with pad disabled show immediate p95 improvement (13:09) and p99 trending down by 13:12. queue depth back to baseline.
jamie: collecting profiling artifacts and will open a perf regression PR referencing this thread. attaching perf.tar.gz to ticket PERF-492.
alex: nice work. postmortem/next steps: 1) revert async_pad default, 2) add batch-size + seq_len guards, 3) add automated knob to disable padding per-host when eviction or noisy-tenant detected, 4) alert on kernel_family_switch_rate > threshold.
ryan: I'll own alert and KV throttle change. jamie owns the kernel selection guard. maria will monitor live metrics and validate nozzle.
alex: thanks team — leave this thread open until rolling fixes are in staging and p99 stabilized for 30m.
